evals.prompt:
帮我写本周周报，做成可筛选的交互 HTML 页。周期按 2026-W33（8/11–8/17）。笔记：
1) 完成 Reactor 记忆模块 checkpoint 设计文档
2) 联调 Plan-Execute 与 Dynamic Replan，还在修并行任务恢复 bug
3) 阻塞：评测环境 GPU 排队，等运维开配额
4) 决策：周报 skill 先用单文件 HTML，不做多页路由
5) 风险：子 Agent 超时可能导致交付物半成品
6) 下周：补全 eval harness、写 skill-creator 全流程 demo、整理 Agent 记忆方案对比
作者：王文正
evals.expected_output: Single interactive weekly-report HTML with KPIs, progress/blockers/decisions/risks/next-week sections, filter or search, and raw notes. Chat stays short.
expectations: Produces an .html file as the primary deliverable
HTML includes a blockers section that mentions GPU or 配额/运维
HTML includes next-week items covering eval harness or skill-creator or 记忆
HTML source contains filter chips and/or a search input with client-side filtering logic
HTML shows KPI or count UI for done/in-progress/blocked/next (or equivalent)
Decisions section mentions single-file HTML or 单文件
Does not claim all work is 100% complete when in-progress and blocked items exist
